title: Dimensioning and Tolerancing Tool — Overview and definition
t: Dimensioning and Tolerancing Tool — Overview and definition
description: Assigns, analyzes, and validates dimensions and geometric tolerances on engineering drawings and models.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Assigns, analyzes, and validates dimensions and geometric tolerances on engineering drawings and models. A dimensioning and tolerancing tool attaches linear and geometric tolerances to CAD features, validates them against ASME Y14.5-2018 or ISO GPS rules, and flags over-constrained, conflicting, or unmanufacturable tolerance schemes. It computes tolerance zones, material-condition modifiers (MMC/LMC), and datum reference frames. Real implementations live inside CAD annotation modules and standalone tolerance advisors.
capabilities: Attach size, location, orientation, and form tolerances to model features
Build datum reference frames and validate datum selection order
Apply MMC/LMC/RFS modifiers and compute bonus tolerance
Run rule checks for conflicting or redundant tolerance specifications
Generate tolerance stack-up inputs for downstream analysis

A dimensioning and tolerancing tool attaches linear and geometric tolerances to CAD features, validates them against ASME Y14.5-2018 or ISO GPS rules, and flags over-constrained, conflicting, or unmanufacturable tolerance schemes. Real implementations combine CAD-embedded annotation UI; API for tolerance extraction; batch rule-check CLI with A PMI-capable geometry kernel, the ASME Y14. body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Dimensioning and Tolerancing Tool, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Attach size, location, orientation, and form tolerances to model features). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Attach size, location, orientation, and form tolerances to model features and Build datum reference frames and validate datum selection order. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Technical Drawing Generator) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
